summary: REGENXBIO Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of common stock. The filing is a shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) to raise $100 million. The offering is priced at market, not a fixed price with a premium, and is a routine capital raise. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change involved. This is an ordinary equity issuance with no special-situation characteristics.
